column1: # Paths ploaness manages in a consumer working tree, because tools ploaness does not run read them from
# there: git, editors, and coding agents cannot resolve a config through node_modules.
#   PINNED    ploaness owns the content; the file must exist and match byte for byte.
#   SEED      ploaness writes it once when absent; the project owns it afterwards.
#   FORBIDDEN the path must not exist, because ploaness supplies that configuration itself.
#   SECTION   ploaness owns the marked block at the top; the project owns the text below it.
# Project documentation belongs to the consuming project. The governing standard and the agent guide are
# the exceptions, because together they declare the contract every agent is held to. CLAUDE.md is a fixed
# tool entry point, and AGENTS.md carries the block that points at all three.
